meanings.note: Plain い-adjective.

examples.text: 彼の英語は本当にすごい。

meanings.note: Polite sentence-ending counterpart of plain だ.

cells: ではありません / じゃありません

meanings.note: Second-person pronoun used by superiors, in songs/books, or between close friends.

examples.text: 君の意見はどうですか。
君ならきっとできるよ。

meanings.en: as for; topic or contrast marker
meanings.note: Written は but pronounced wa when marking the topic or contrasting one item with another.

examples.text: 君は素養があるね、違いが分かるってことは。
examples.trans: You have real refinement, being able to tell the difference.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Marks the subject of existence, emergence, or questions (どれが), and at the end of a polite clause softens a request (のですが).

examples.text: お願いがあるのですが。
examples.trans: I have a favor to ask.

meanings.en: exist; be available; remain in place
meanings.note: Used for inanimate things and abstract concepts; after て-form (書いてある, 置いてある) describes a resulting state left in place.

examples.text: 名前が書いてあります。

meanings.note: Checks agreement ('isn't it?') or softens a request or farewell.

examples.text: 君は素養があるね、違いが分かるってことは。
examples.trans: You have real refinement, being able to tell the difference.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: 分かってる asks or states ongoing understanding; plain past 分かった means 'got it! / I understand'.

examples.text: 日本語が少し分かります。

examples.trans: Got it, I will come right away.

meanings.note: Refers to facts, matters, or affairs rather than physical objects (もの).

examples.text: 仕事のことを話します。

meanings.en: location of action; means; scope total
meanings.note: Marks where an action happens, the unit/scope of a rate or total (十日で, 全部で), or the cause/occasion.

examples.trans: It is one thousand yen in total.

meanings.en: what kind of; what sort of
meanings.note: Interrogative prenominal modifier.

examples.text: どんな音楽を聴きますか。
examples.trans: What kind of music do you listen to?

examples.text: どんな仕事をしているんですか。
examples.trans: What kind of work do you do?

examples.text: で、お母さんはどんな様子かな？
examples.trans: So, how is your mother doing?

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Turns a statement into a question, or softens a volitional/negative guess.

meanings.en: casual reflection or firm reminder particle
meanings.note: Used aloud to oneself ('man, I'm hungry') or at the end of a warning ('remember that, okay?').
All-purpose action verb; turns Sino-Japanese nouns into verbs (融通する, 出店する) and with に means 'decide on' or 'make into'.
Written を and pronounced o; marks what an action directly acts upon.
Prefixed to native Japanese words (お店, お二人, お持ち帰り) to add politeness.
Softens a refusal or correction at the start of a reply.
Links a modifying noun to a following noun, or turns a clause into an explanatory statement (often contracted to ん in speech).

examples.text: いや、我々の務めだからね。
examples.trans: Not at all, it is simply our duty.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.en: in that way; that is so
meanings.note: そうですか ('Is that so? / I see') calmly acknowledges news.

examples.text: そうですか、わかりました。

meanings.note: Means 'spot' in 近いところ, and 'as far as today goes' in 今日のところは.

examples.text: 静かなところが好きです。
今のところは順調です。
examples.trans: For the moment, things are going smoothly.

meanings.note: Transitive ichidan verb.

examples.text: 毎日運動を続けています。
三か月続けてみてください。
examples.trans: Please try keeping it up for three months.

meanings.en: go forward; work out well (いけます = 'it will work!')
meanings.note: Written in kana for figurative headway: いけます! ('this can go / this will work!'), 思いどおりにいかない ('does not go as hoped').

examples.text: この企画ならいけます！
examples.trans: With this plan, it will work!

examples.text: 仕事がうまくいっています。

meanings.note: In casual speech, それ plus は often fuses into そりゃ ('well, as for that / of course').
Adverb.

examples.text: まだ終わっていません。

meanings.note: Directly modifies a noun near the speaker (この店, この辺, この部分).

examples.text: この本は人気があります。

meanings.note: Asks about condition, outcome (どうだった), or what happened (どうしましたか).

meanings.en: do for an inferior (tough-guy てやる)
meanings.note: After て-form (勘弁してやる), expresses granting a favor from a position of authority.

examples.trans: I will give you a hand (casual masculine).

meanings.note: Godan verb.

examples.text: 客を口説いて契約を取る。
examples.trans: Persuade the customer and get the contract.

examples.text: 何度口説いても断られた。
examples.trans: No matter how many times I tried to persuade him, he refused.

meanings.en: to think; to feel; to believe
